zh: 每个长度为 3 的子串都由它的右端位置唯一确定，所以只要在扫描到每个右端时检查一次即可，不会重复也不会遗漏。
维护一个长度为 3 的滑动窗口里元音的个数：右边加入一个字符，左边移出三格之前的字符，计数始终准确，窗口满 3 个字符后计数为 2 就算一个。
读入整行（可能为空串）。从左到右遍历下标 i：若 s[i] 是元音则计数加一；若 i≥3 且 s[i−3] 是元音则计数减一；若 i≥2 且计数恰为 2，答案加一。最后输出答案，空串和长度不足 3 的串答案为 0。
en: Every substring of length 3 is identified uniquely by its right end, so checking once when the scan reaches each right end counts every window exactly once.

Keep the number of vowels in a sliding window of length 3: add the character entering on the right and remove the one three positions back, so the count stays exact; once the window holds 3 characters, count it when the vowel count is 2.

Read the whole line, which may be empty. For each index i from left to right: if s[i] is a vowel, increase the count; if i >= 3 and s[i - 3] is a vowel, decrease it; if i >= 2 and the count is exactly 2, increase the answer. Output the answer; an empty string or one shorter than 3 gives 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the number of vowels among the last three characters; once the window has length 3, add one to the answer whenever the count is 2.

## Correctness

Each window of length 3 is checked exactly once, when the scan reaches its right end. Adding the new character and removing the character three positions back keeps the window's vowel count exact.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1).
